description: Panel that lists saved Gantt reports and lets the user run an existing one; a "New report" button is shown only when the host handles OnNewReportRequested. Each entry shows the report name and type, with a run action that raises the corresponding callback.

parameters.name: OnReportRun
parameters.description: Fires when the user clicks "Run" on a report.

parameters.name: OnNewReportRequested
parameters.description: Fires when the user asks for a new report. The panel has no report editor of its own, so the "New report" button is only rendered when the host handles this callback.
